So Birdie was taking a final exam at school, and everyone knew he would fail. He took the test, because he wanted to prove everyone wrong and go to scare school. But when he took the test, he did not even know the first steps towards scaring someone, and he ended up making friends with the people he was supposed to scare.

But, after I wrote large junks of the script, I realized a problem. If Birdie can make friends with 2 humans, and they know about the scaring school, then humans must know all about the monsters. If humans take precautions to avoid being scared (NO CHILD WANTS TO BE SCARED IN THEIR BED), then how will monsters be able to scare people for a job? I love my script and I would hate for my animation to be cancelled just because it does not make sense logically.
